podcast.body: This album was the result of a demo recorded by Kim Deal, funded by an $11,000 grant from The Pixies' UK record label, and featured "a few tweaks to the lineup." "There were a few tweaks to the lineup and the result was now called Pod."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This was one of the early albums released by The Breeders, formed by Kim Deal when she sought more creative input than she could achieve with the Pixies. "There was one album called POD"

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Kim Deal, the bassist of Pixies, enlisted Steve Albini to record *Pod*, The Breeders' first album. Albini demonstrated a perfect understanding of The Breeders' musical vision for *Pod*, employing his characteristic classic recording model while incorporating experimental and innovative sounds. "Albindli entendió la perfección la propuesta de Debriders y sopa Pindi, donde volvió a aplicar ese modelo de grabación clásico pero contó que se experimentales innovadores."
